entities.summary: Kamyar Abdi is an Iranian anthropologist and professor of Near Eastern archaeology at Shahid Beheshti University. After studying theoretical physics for a year, he began his undergraduate studies in archaeology at Tehran University, leading to a master's degree. Afterwards, he enrolled in the Oriental Institute of the University of Chicago in 1994 to study Near Eastern archaeology, history, and languages. Abdi received his PhD in Anthropological Archaeology from the University of Michigan in 2002, under the supervision of Henry T.
